author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Ultra-Fine Sweep (2/2): alpha=0.11
abstract:
This is the second run of an ultra-fine sweep for `correction_alpha` centered on the observed
peak at alpha=0.1 (score 0.7444). This run tests a slightly higher value, alpha=0.11,
to exhaust the search for an optimal value in this immediate region.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from synergy_gene_correction_v2 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as gene_correction_v2_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  # Ultra-Fine Sweep Run 2: Test alpha = 0.11
  return gene_correction_v2_fn(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.65, 
        delta=0.04, 
        kdensity=18, 
        k_total=50,
        correction_alpha=0.11,
        rng_seed=1
    )
